name: Tobe Hiroko
source:
The beautiful, kimono-clad proprietress of a set-meal restaurant and izakaya. A widow with a stunningly voluptuous figure.

She got married three years ago, but her husband died of a stroke shortly after the wedding. For the past three years, Hiroko has been running the business on her own, leading a lonely life.

She’s what you’d call a natural nuturer, filled with a spirit of attentive service; she gets pleasure from devoting herself to others and is passionate about it. She's also a ditz, however she's unaware of this.

There’s something about the protagonist that tickles her maternal instincts, so even beyond meals, she can’t help but take care of him in more intimate ways as well.


[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/366945/]Getchu[/url]]
